working_definition: Author type 'Tm29' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm29 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'Tm29' is FBbt:00049916 'transmedullary neuron Tm29'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052328 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron that receives most of its input in around 5 columns of medulla layer M6, where it also has a small number of presynapses (Nern et al., 2025). It also has a small amount of arborization in the rest of M3-M8 (Nern et al., 2025). It crosses the second optic chiasm and has mixed pre- and post-synapses in around 3 columns of lobula layer 5B (Nern et al., 2025). It is glutamatergic (Davis et al., 2020). There are around 170-270 of these cells per hemisphere (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052328 'immature transmedullary neuron Tm29' (exact match).
